CardAnswered.description:
The card ``id`` was answered (``card.answer`` accepted); it is closed.

Stamped and kept in the ring, so a replay that carries the ``card.ask``
also carries its closing and the app does not pin the card again.
CardAnswered.title: CardAnswered

ChatCompacted.description: The engine summarized earlier conversation to make room.
ChatCompacted.title: ChatCompacted

ChatNotice.description: A quiet line in the conversation from the gateway, e.g. an unknown command.
ChatNotice.title: ChatNotice

ClientMessage.description: Any app -> gateway message, discriminated on type.

ConfigStale.description: The config file changed after the gateway started; restart the gateway to apply it.
ConfigStale.title: ConfigStale

ContextUsage.description: How full the session's context window is, after each turn.
ContextUsage.title: ContextUsage

FilesSearch.description: Search names and text under a root; answered with ``files.results``.
FilesSearch.title: FilesSearch

GatewayStop.description:
Stop the gateway: interrupt every running turn, run ``on_stop``, exit.

Distinct from quitting the app, which only detaches.
GatewayStop.title: GatewayStop

Hit.description: One search result: ``path`` is relative to the searched root.
Hit.title: Hit

ServerMessage.description: Any gateway -> app message, discriminated on type.

Service.description:
One of the deployment's services (v0.4), as its check last found it.

``since`` is when the current state began (ISO 8601 UTC); ``detail`` one
line for the menu; ``can_restart`` whether the deployment gave it a
``restart`` command.
Service.title: Service

ServiceRestart.description:
Run a service's ``restart`` command, then check it again (v0.4).

Answered by the ``services.status`` that follows.
ServiceRestart.title: ServiceRestart

ServicesStatus.description: Every deployment service and its state, down ones first (v0.4).
ServicesStatus.title: ServicesStatus

SessionLog.description:
Run the deployment's log step in the live session ``chat`` without ending it (v0.4).

Answered with ``session.logged`` then ``chat.list``.
SessionLog.title: SessionLog

SessionLogged.description: The log step ``session.log`` asked for has run; ``chat`` is the session's summary now (v0.4).
SessionLogged.title: SessionLogged

SessionMode.description: Change the session's permission mode; answered with ``chat.state`` carrying ``mode``.
SessionMode.title: SessionMode

SessionRenew.description:
End the session ``chat`` and start the next one in the same folder.

With ``log`` the gateway first runs the deployment's log step in the
ending session and waits for it. Answered with ``session.renewed``.
SessionRenew.title: SessionRenew

SessionRenewed.description: The session ``ended`` was closed and ``next`` is the live one now.
SessionRenewed.title: SessionRenewed

UpdateAvailable.description: The deployment's update check found a newer version.
UpdateAvailable.title: UpdateAvailable

UserText.description:
What the person sent to start a turn, as the engine received it.

Live, right after ``turn.started`` (stamped, in the ring), and in a
transcript replay (``chat.history``, unstamped): one rendering path
for the person's words whichever way the conversation arrives.
UserText.title: UserText
